# Arenova Frontdesk

> AI-Powered WhatsApp Receptionist & Appointment Automation Software for Clinics

Arenova Frontdesk (https://frontdesk.arenova.in) is a B2B Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform built for healthcare practices, dental clinics, dermatology clinics, and medical offices. It connects with a clinic's WhatsApp Business number and Google Calendar to handle patient enquiries, provide standard procedure fees and timings, and coordinate appointment requests 24/7.

Arenova Frontdesk is a product of Arenova (https://arenova.in), an AI Automation & Marketing Agency.

## Core Capabilities

- **24/7 WhatsApp AI Receptionist**: Context-aware conversational AI that answers routine patient enquiries, practice hours, and clinic location.
- **Appointment Request Coordination**: Directly coordinates booking requests with the clinic's Google Calendar to prevent double-bookings.
- **Practice FAQ & Fee Guidance**: Accurately shares procedure prep, durations, and standard consultation fees.
- **Clinical Safety Protocols**: Detects acute medical red flags and immediately directs patients to local emergency services (112 / 911).
- **1-Click Human Takeover**: Reception teams can pause the AI and chat directly with any patient from the inbox canvas.
- **Google Review Requests**: Automatically prompts patients post-appointment for feedback and Google reviews.

## Pricing & Subscription (Indian Rupees - INR)

- **Starter Practice**: ₹999/month (₹9,590/year) — 500 AI chats/mo, 1 WhatsApp number, 1 practice location.
- **Pro Practice**: ₹1,499/month (₹14,390/year) — 1,500 AI chats/mo, priority response, calendar sync.
- **Growth Clinic**: ₹2,999/month (₹28,790/year) — 4,000 AI chats/mo, multi-provider calendar scheduling.

International plans are billed in USD ($100/mo Starter, $250/mo Pro, $400/mo Growth) with Crypto (USDT/USDC/ETH/SOL) support.
